findings.action: Retain the existing behavioral-review obligation when removing the prefix. Treat a release-only observation as insufficient through reviewer judgment even when its target keys match. findings.action: Require an exact same-scenario deterministic comparison before claiming benefit: measure the existing correction-and-reexecution path's total worker calls and interventions, then the candidate path's calls and both final consumer outputs. Reuse the unchanged delivered fixture to test candidate consumption where possible; record zero additional calls only if observed. Retain focused negative controls for legacy wrong scope, invalid structured membership, missing/non-pass observations, absent evidence, and identity/delivery failures.
